fields.notes: Detonate Time Trap is put on cooldown every time a new Time Trap is placed.

abilities.name: Sand Blast
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, fire a missile that deals 305 damage to the first enemy hit. Deals 50% damage to Structures. Casting Sand Blast leaves an Echo behind that mimics Chromie's Sand Blast and Basic Attack, dealing 40% damage. Maximum of 1 Echo active at a time.

fields.notes: Sand Blasts fired by Sand Echoes count for Sand Blast related talents and quests. Sand Echoes' Basic Attacks deal Physical Damage. Sand Echoes' damage reduction stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Dragon's Breath
abilities.description: Launch 3 blasts into the air that land every 0.75 seconds toward the targeted direction, dealing 215 damage each.

fields.notes: First blast lands 0.75 seconds after a successful cast. First cast point determines the location of first blast and second the direction of following blasts.

abilities.name: Time Trap
abilities.description: Place a Time Trap that arms and Stealths after 2 seconds. Chromie's Trait can be activated to detonate the trap, placing all nearby allied or enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 2 seconds. Maximum of 1 trap active at a time. Time Trap

abilities.name: Slowing Sands
abilities.description: mana 5 Mana per second custom=1 Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.; 5; Heroic

fields.notes: Slowing Sands is interrupted and put on cooldown when Chromie cancels the ability, runs out of Mana or moves 30 units away from it. Each Hero has their own stack counter. Stacks are reset immediately when the affected Hero leaves the area. 0.75 Mana is consumed per tick. Cannot be picked in ARAM games.

abilities.name: Temporal Loop
abilities.description: Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them. Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.; 50; 60; Heroic

fields.notes: Temporal Loop cannot be removed, but its displacement effect will be prevented if the target is Unstoppable when it triggers.
